ecommerce-livestream-overlay-generator v1.0.1

- Updated host persona prompt guidelines: the background color should be described as "pure solid green" (not "#00FF00") rather than "pure deep green".
- Aligned language for background color requirements for consistency in both background and host persona prompts.
- No code changes; documentation update only.

Give your AI Agent a single sentence, and it will automatically generate a complete set of livestream overlay graphics.

For example, just say:

Create a full FILA livestream overlay set. Featured products: Cat Paw Shoes and Mars Shoes. ¥150 off every ¥1,100. Buy 2 pairs, get a free collab bucket hat. VIP exclusive limited gift box packaging.

You can also upload a product photo, and the AI will recognize it and auto-generate everything.

In about 1 minute, you'll receive: Preview example (Chow Tai Fook): https://metagc-cdn.aminer.cn/baolian/975be8203ef511f196c2ea516938c8a791.jpg

A complete set of livestream overlays: background, title banner, host persona, pricing card, product shelf, benefits bar, plus a composite preview image. Each component is delivered as a separate PNG with transparency, ready for editing and repositioning.
